name: How do apartment builders handle change orders?

mainEntity.name: What is a normal change-order process in Los Angeles apartment construction, and how can owners avoid budget surprises?
mainEntity.text: What is a normal change-order process in Los Angeles apartment construction, and how can owners avoid budget surprises?

acceptedAnswer.text: Change orders are a normal part of apartment construction, but they should be managed carefully. A proper process documents the change, explains the reason, shows the cost or time impact, and gets approval before the work proceeds whenever possible. That protects both the owner and the contractor from misunderstandings. The best way to reduce change orders is to make decisions early, confirm allowances, and finalize drawings before construction starts. In Los Angeles, design revisions can be especially costly once permitting or field work is underway because they may trigger re-review or rework. Owners should ask how the builder tracks changes, what requires written approval, and how pricing is calculated. A transparent change-order system is one of the clearest signs that a contractor is organized and experienced.
